description: Verify that the Equipment Action Reason Configuration section displays all required actions and their associated reasons correctly
preconditions: Valid Despachoprevio SSO credentials must be available
User has access to Configuration section
Equipment Action Reason Configuration is set up in the system

test_steps.expected_result: Login page is displayed with 'Login with Despachoprevio' button

test_steps.action: Click on 'Login with Despachoprevio' button to authenticate
test_steps.expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to main application

test_steps.action: Click on Configuration icon from the left menu
Navigate to Equipment Action Reason Configuration section
test_steps.expected_result: Equipment Action Reason Configuration page is displayed

test_steps.action: Verify presence of all specified actions and their associated reasons
test_steps.test_data: Expected actions: Cargue Diferido, Descargue Diferido, Liberación Diferida, No Despacho previo, Rechazo
test_steps.expected_result: All actions are visible with non-empty reason values in the configuration table
